_comment: The posture the checks compare against. Every value is the program's position (design guidance) unless the note says Learn; change it in a reviewed pull request, and record why. The settings file (one per environment) holds the estate's own IDs.
minimumDefaultRuleSetNote: Learn recommends the latest Default Rule Set, 2.2 at the guide's reading (azs-agw-secure); the CLI's default is 2.1
allowedAppGwSslPoliciesNote: Learn names AppGwSslPolicy20220101 as an example of a predefined policy with TLS 1.2 or 1.3 only, and shows AppGwSslPolicy20220101S (azs-ingress, azs-agw-tls)
